brief:
Settlers have established a new outpost near the town of Imaatin east of Qalqiliya, Maan Wire reported. The move marks another instance of settlement expansion in areas adjacent to Palestinian population centers in the northern West Bank.

The outpost's establishment comes amid ongoing tensions over unauthorized settlement activity in occupied Palestinian territory. Israeli authorities have faced international criticism over such expansions, though settler movements continue despite legal challenges and occasional removal orders.
title: Settlers establish new outpost near Imaatin east of Qalqiliya
